items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-10-21
items.q: They had that. They got that. Who wrote it out for you? It was Dumaine. He written all the things out.

ctx.x: I love it myself. I love the place. Well, now, upper garden, do you play that by head with the Eureka?

No, no, no, no, no, no. They had that. They got that. Who wrote it out for you? It was Dumaine. He written all the things out. It's a little piece of piece, but that's why the manuscript was here. Uh-huh. Yeah. Well, now, where did Dumaine get him from? The book.

Would that be a hymn book or? Yes. It would be a hymn book he got out from, huh? That's what I see the book. Whee! And so, what would he have in the hymn book? He would have words? Words, new books. And what kind of music would go with it?
